summary.content:
Today's selection covers 78 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 45 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI Is Showing Kalshi’s World Cup Odds in ChatGPT
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Spanish Police take down €140 million cyber fraud ring, arrest four
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, Krebs on Security, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 62 articles published in the last 24 hours
